name: EBL Patterning HSQ
body:
Dose: 3500 µC/cm²
Beam current: 5 nA 120 aperture 
Beam step size: 3 nm - 4nm
Field size: 500um to 1000um
Field overlap: Depends on the component, usually 10-50um
PEC: absolutely necessery. Mid range needs to be activated with Nue of 0.1
Field needs to be controlled for following line.

files.name: 1_007.jpg
files.note: Insufficient PEC leads to delamination of smaller isolated feature
